_note: What the automatic writer/director may use. Every pose here has passed face QA. Add new items only after QA (see creative/puppet/README.md).

barber_shop.desc: Rocky's small barber shop in Kanpur: mint-green walls, shelves of bottles, hairstyle poster, ceiling fan. (Dev's seated pose brings its own barber chair.)

barber_chair.desc: Same barber shop with the empty red barber chair visible. Only for standing characters (never with dev_seated).

flat.desc: Dev and Meera's shared rented flat: warm living room, orange sofa with a sleeping cat, fairy lights, floor lamp, bookshelf.

dev.desc: Dev, mid-20s IT guy, mustard hoodie with office ID badge. Polite to a fault, cannot say no to anyone, over-thinks, inner voice panics. Speaks soft, hesitant Hindi with English office words.

rocky.desc: Rocky, 40s barber, pink shirt, black apron, moustache, big belly. Overconfident Kanpur style ('guru', 'bhaukaal', 'kaahe'), sells everything as a masterpiece, never admits a mistake.

meera.desc: Meera, mid-20s, Dev's flatmate, black tee, checked pyjamas, teal hair streak, always eating chips. Deadpan, few words, devastating one-liners, sees through everyone.

dev_nono.desc: both palms up in front: 'no no', defensive, protesting

dev_seated.desc: sitting in the red barber chair wearing a white cape (barber_shop set only)

rocky_phone.desc: looking at his phone in both hands

rocky_scissors.desc: holding scissors up, other hand on belly, salesman mode

rocky_tada.desc: arms flung wide: 'ta-da!' presentation (solo shots only)

meera_point.desc: holding chips, pointing to the side (at someone)

dev_phone.desc: standing, holding a smartphone to his right ear with his right hand, left arm relaxed by his side

meera_phone.desc: standing, holding a smartphone to her right ear with her right hand, a chips packet in her left hand

dev_holdup.desc: standing, right hand holding up a small blue card (like an ATM/ID card) at shoulder height, left hand holding a smartphone flat at chest height on speaker. The card is the only object he can show in this pose.

hair_variants._note: Only for the haircut episodes: Dev's pose names with _bowl or _tuft give him the bad haircut.

sfx.snips: scissors snipping (only when scissors are used on screen)
sfx.shutter: phone camera shutter (only when someone takes a photo)
sfx.spiral: used automatically under Dev's inner-voice panic; do not add it yourself
